faq.q: What is the origin of Elif?
faq.a: Elif is associated with Arabic. Elif is the Turkish form of Arabic أَلِف (Alif), the first letter of the Arabic alphabet; it also conveys 'slender'.
Yes — the underlying form أَلِف is Arabic.
Elif can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Elif should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root أ ل ف is Quranic, but Alif is not itself a Quranic personal name.
